1.Title: Bloodthirst
1.Description: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Maim</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Sharp DMG</color> dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
